fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 4 darting bites in a wide spread, each dealing 3 damage. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Thrash Loose
fusions.desc: Thrashes free of the target, dealing 12 damage, knocking it 2.5 tiles back and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Through the Fingers
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds, slips you 2 tiles from where you stood, and gives you 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a blow that would land on you is rolled again against your dodge, and the second roll stands.
